title: Act 3 - Chapter 3: Kin Island, Bond Bridge & Berry Forest (Jasmine & Mineral Badge)
synopsis: Leap across the Old Shipwreck chasm using the Golbat Boots to reach Brine Road East and Kin Island, the bustling heart of the Sevii archipelago. Journey north across the scenic Bond Bridge to gather fresh bananas and recover a fallen Spaceship Part near the waterfall. Enter the lush Berry Forest to help Gym Leader Jasmine rescue her missing nephew, gather rare damage-halving berries, and defeat a disguised static Zoroark. Return to Bond Bridge to face Jasmine in an official 5 vs 5 duel for the Mineral Badge, Magnemite Hairclips, and a gift Mareanie to part the Brine Road Corsola barrier.
